title: South Korea Plans Security Guidelines for AI Agents
description: The Korea Internet and Security Agency (KISA), South Korea’s principal internet security agency, said on Tuesday it is developing safety guidelines for agentic AI — that is, artificial intelligence programs that can operate without direct human supervision.
